title: Corn on the Cob Side Dish Ideas for Memorial Day
meta_description: Discover tasty Memorial Day corn side dishes, from charred buttered kernels to spicy Mexican street corn, plus how the Girla Interlocking Corn on the Cob Holder
html:
Memorial Day gatherings often revolve around the grill, and nothing says summer like a row of sweet, juicy corn on the cob. When you pair that classic staple with a few creative twists, you get a lineup of memorial day corn side dishes that will keep guests reaching for seconds. Below are four crowd‑pleasing ideas, plus tips on using the Girla Interlocking Corn on the Cob Holders Set to keep everything tidy and mess‑free.

1. Classic Butter‑And‑Herb Grilled Corn

This is the baseline every backyard cook starts with, but a few small upgrades turn it from ordinary to unforgettable.

  • Ingredients: fresh ears of corn, unsalted butter, chopped fresh herbs (parsley, chives, thyme), kosher salt, cracked black pepper, and a squeeze of lemon.
  • Method: Preheat the grill to medium‑high. Brush each ear with melted butter, sprinkle with herbs, salt, and pepper, then grill 10‑12 minutes, turning every few minutes for even char. Finish with a drizzle of lemon juice.

The herbs add brightness while the lemon cuts through the richness. Serve the hot cobs on the Girla Interlocking Corn on the Cob Holders; the silicone grips keep fingers clean and the interlocking design means you can stack the holders for easy transport from the grill to the buffet table.

2. Mexican Street Corn (Elote) Remix

Elote is a party favorite, and it works perfectly as a side dish for Memorial Day picnics. The creamy sauce and spicy kick make it a conversation starter.

What you need: grilled corn, mayonnaise, cotija cheese, chili powder, smoked paprika, lime zest, and fresh cilantro.

After grilling the corn, spread a thin layer of mayo on each ear, then sprinkle generously with crumbled cotija, chili powder, smoked paprika, and lime zest. Finish with chopped cilantro. The Girla Interlocking Corn on the Cob Holders let guests hold the messy cobs without getting sauce on their hands, and the bright silicone handles add a pop of color to your spread.

3. Sweet‑And‑Spicy Honey‑Sriracha Glazed Corn

For those who love a balance of sweet and heat, this glaze is quick to make and sticks beautifully to the kernels.

  1. Whisk together ¼ cup honey, 2 tbsp sriracha, 1 tsp soy sauce, and a pinch of smoked salt.
  2. Brush the glaze onto hot, grilled corn, then return to the grill for 2‑3 minutes per side, letting the sauce caramelize.
  3. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and a handful of chopped green onions before serving.

The glaze creates a sticky, glossy finish that looks great on a platter. Using the Girla Interlocking Corn on the Cob Holders keeps the sticky glaze off your guests' fingers and makes cleanup a snap—just pop the holders in the dishwasher.

4. Cheesy Bacon‑Wrapped Corn Bites

If you want a handheld, indulgent option, try cutting the cob into bite‑size sections, wrapping each piece with half a slice of bacon, and topping with shredded cheddar.

Secure the bacon with a toothpick, then grill until the bacon crisps and the cheese melts—about 5‑7 minutes. These mini corn bites are perfect for a Memorial Day appetizer table. The Girla Interlocking Corn on the Cob Holders aren’t needed for the bites themselves, but they’re handy for serving the remaining whole cobs alongside the appetizers, keeping the presentation cohesive.

5. Refreshing Corn & Avocado Salad

Not every side has to be on the cob. A chilled salad lets you enjoy corn’s sweetness in a cooler format, ideal for hot July weather.

Combine: grilled corn kernels (cut off the cob), diced avocado, cherry tomatoes, thinly sliced red onion, chopped cilantro, and a dressing of lime juice, olive oil, salt, and a pinch of cumin. Toss gently and chill for 15 minutes before serving.

This salad pairs well with the grilled corn dishes above, offering a fresh contrast. If you’re serving whole cobs on the side, the Girla Interlocking Corn on the Cob Holders keep the salad bowls separate from the sticky hands‑on corn, maintaining a tidy buffet.

Tips for Perfect Memorial Day Corn Side Dishes

Even with great recipes, a few practical pointers make a difference:

  • Choose fresh corn: Look for ears with bright green husks and moist silk. Fresh kernels are sweeter and hold up better on the grill.
  • Soak husks if you like steam‑grilled corn: Soaking prevents them from burning and adds a gentle steam that keeps kernels juicy.
  • Season after grilling: Salt can draw moisture out, so add most seasonings once the corn is off the heat.
  • Use the Girla Interlocking Corn on the Cob Holders: The silicone handles stay cool, the interlocking feature saves storage space, and they’re dishwasher‑safe—no extra scrubbing.

FAQ

Can I use the Girla Interlocking Corn on the Cob Holders for hot corn straight off the grill?

Yes. The silicone handles stay cool to the touch, so you can serve hot cobs without burning fingers.

How do I clean the corn holders after a messy BBQ?

They are dishwasher‑safe, but a quick rinse under warm water and a mild scrub will remove any butter or sauce residue before loading them into the dishwasher.

Do the holders work with other grilled vegetables?

Absolutely. The interlocking design holds anything with a similar shape—like asparagus bundles or grilled zucchini spears—making them a versatile addition to any outdoor kitchen.
